concepts.proposed_markdown: The SDK reference says the Python, Go, Ruby, and Node.js clients automatically retry each request upon failure up to three times by default and allow the count to be configured. It does not identify retryable statuses or exceptions, attempt counting, backoff, jitter, timeout behavior, method safety, or whether retries inject or preserve an API-wide `Idempotency-Key`. Event `transaction_id` is a separate usage-deduplication identity and must not be generalized to billable-metric, customer, product, rate-card, rate, or contract creation. [[source-metronome-api-reference-sdks]]
warnings: Keep generic SDK retry behavior separate from the API-wide same-key POST result-replay contract and every endpoint-specific state and recovery boundary.
Do not infer that automatic retries make every mutation safe after an ambiguous result.
